This is a Signature-original design study, explicitly labeled and never presented as public record. Baseline reference: U.S. carrier class; 3 built; armored decks; Midway served 1945-1991 (47 years).. The Midway class — three ships — were the first U.S. carriers too large for the Panama Canal, with armored flight decks. Midway herself served 47 years, from 1945 to Desert Storm in 1991, the longest U.S. carrier career. USS Midway is now a museum in San Diego.
